fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled checkpoint found. The campus has only a landscaped grass buffer along Wendland Rd with a Niagara monument sign at the entrance driveway (Street View 2026-04) — no perimeter security fence, no barrier arm and no guard booth across any driveway. Classified false, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed-booth structure visible at any entrance. A small white structure near the main plant NE corner appears to be a process/utility building, not a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of two large Niagara buildings: the original ~728,000 sq ft manufacturing plant (north) and the $48M logistics-center expansion (south), connected by an internal road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main plant has a long dock bank on its east face with trailers backed in; the logistics center has dock banks on its south/north faces. Combined estimate ~90 doors across both buildings — 50+ band confident.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer yards at both buildings hold 80+ tractor-trailers and drop trailers in marked rows; 50+ band, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Separate dock clusters on the two distinct buildings (manufacturing plant vs. logistics center) imply physically separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide internal roads and broad aprons with substantial unused paved width leave clear room for bypass/express lanes.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved yards between the internal roads and the dock doors at both buildings provide ample post-gate staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately south of the logistics center with rail cars on it, but it is a separate mainline/siding — no spur enters the Niagara property; classified not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the Temple Industrial Park on the edge of Temple, surrounded by farm fields — Rural setting.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two driveway connections to Wendland Rd serve the campus; counted as 2 truck gates (both uncontrolled).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~78 acres derived from the perimeter box covering both buildings, their dock aprons and trailer yards.
